title: Thailand & the Malay Peninsula
author: Holiday Planner contributors
attribution: Descriptions are written for this project. Linked pages (Wikivoyage, Wikipedia) are cited as sources and are not copied; they remain under their own licences.

coverage.description: Fifteen destinations across Thailand, Malaysia and Singapore, with planning-level travel times between them. No timetables, fares or live availability.

places.name: Bangkok
places.summary: Thailand's capital: royal temples by the river, street food at every hour, markets, rooftop bars and an efficient rail and boat network.

seasonGuidance.note: Approximate guidance: rainy season roughly May to October; November to February is usually cooler and drier. Check a forecast.

places.name: Ayutthaya
places.summary: The ruined former royal capital north of Bangkok, a UNESCO World Heritage site best seen by bike or on foot early in the day.

seasonGuidance.note: Approximate guidance: rainy season roughly May to October; November to February is usually cooler and drier. Check a forecast.

places.name: Chiang Mai
places.summary: Northern Thailand's cultural centre: a walled old city full of temples, night markets, cooking schools and mountains within an hour's drive.

seasonGuidance.note: Approximate guidance: rainy season roughly May to October. Smoke haze from agricultural burning is often reported around March and April. Check air quality and a forecast.

places.name: Ko Samui
places.summary: The largest of the Gulf islands, with an airport, long sandy beaches on the east coast and boat trips to the Ang Thong marine park.

seasonGuidance.note: Approximate guidance: the Gulf islands usually get their heaviest rain around October to December, a different pattern from the Andaman coast. Check a forecast.

places.name: Ko Pha-ngan
places.summary: A ferry hop from Samui: famous for the full-moon party at Hat Rin, but most of the island is quiet coves, jungle and waterfalls.

seasonGuidance.note: Approximate guidance: the Gulf islands usually get their heaviest rain around October to December, a different pattern from the Andaman coast. Check a forecast.

places.name: Ko Tao
places.summary: A small, hilly island known for learning to dive and for snorkelling in clear water, with short hikes to viewpoints.

seasonGuidance.note: Approximate guidance: the Gulf islands usually get their heaviest rain around October to December, a different pattern from the Andaman coast. Check a forecast.

places.name: Khao Sok National Park
places.summary: Old rainforest and limestone peaks between the two coasts, with a dammed lake where you can sleep on floating raft houses.

seasonGuidance.note: Approximate guidance: a rainforest that gets rain in most months, heaviest roughly May to November. Check a forecast.

places.name: Phuket
places.summary: Thailand's biggest island and a major airport: busy west-coast beaches, a characterful old town, and boat trips into Phang Nga Bay.

seasonGuidance.note: Approximate guidance: the Andaman coast is usually wettest from about May to October; November to April is the drier season. Check a forecast.

places.name: Krabi (Ao Nang)
places.summary: The mainland base for Krabi's limestone islands: longtail boats leave the beach for island-hopping, and Railay is minutes away.

seasonGuidance.note: Approximate guidance: the Andaman coast is usually wettest from about May to October; November to April is the drier season. Check a forecast.

places.name: Railay
places.summary: A headland reached only by boat, walled in by limestone cliffs: rock climbing, cave beaches and dramatic sunsets.

seasonGuidance.note: Approximate guidance: the Andaman coast is usually wettest from about May to October; November to April is the drier season. Check a forecast.

places.name: Ko Lanta
places.summary: A long, relaxed island with a string of west-coast beaches, a national park at its southern tip and an old town built on stilts.

seasonGuidance.note: Approximate guidance: wettest from about May to October, when many smaller businesses close and some boats stop. Check a forecast.

places.name: Kuala Lumpur
places.summary: Malaysia's capital mixes Malay, Chinese and Indian food and culture: hawker streets, the Petronas Towers and the Batu Caves temples.

seasonGuidance.note: Approximate guidance: rain is possible all year; the inter-monsoon months around April and October–November are often the wettest. Check a forecast.

places.name: George Town (Penang)
places.summary: A UNESCO-listed port town of shophouses, clan houses and street art, and one of the best places in the region to eat at hawker stalls.

seasonGuidance.note: Approximate guidance: usually wettest around September to November. Check a forecast.

places.name: Langkawi
places.summary: An island geopark off Malaysia's north-west coast: mangrove rivers, a cable car to a sky bridge, and easygoing beaches.

seasonGuidance.note: Approximate guidance: usually wettest from about May to October. Check a forecast.

places.name: Singapore
places.summary: A compact city-state with superb public transport, hawker centres, ambitious gardens and distinct neighbourhoods to walk.

seasonGuidance.note: Approximate guidance: warm all year; usually wettest around November to January. Check a forecast.

activities.title: Grand Palace and Wat Phra Kaew
activities.summary: The former royal residence and the temple of the Emerald Buddha. Go early; a dress code applies.
activities.schedulingNote: Covered shoulders and knees are expected. Check current opening hours.

activities.title: Wat Arun by river ferry
activities.summary: Cross the Chao Phraya to the riverside Temple of Dawn, best in the late afternoon light.

activities.title: Chatuchak Weekend Market
activities.summary: One of the world's largest markets: food, crafts, plants and vintage clothes.
activities.schedulingNote: A weekend market. Check current opening days and hours.

activities.title: Street food on Yaowarat (Chinatown)
activities.summary: An evening walk along Chinatown's main street as the food stalls open.

activities.title: Chao Phraya Express Boat ride
activities.summary: Use the river boats as a cheap sightseeing route past temples and old warehouses.

activities.title: Rooftop bar at sunset
activities.summary: Bangkok's skyline from one of its many rooftop bars.

activities.title: Ayutthaya Historical Park
activities.summary: Brick temples and Buddha images from the old capital, spread over a river island.

activities.title: Cycle between the ruins
activities.summary: Rent a bicycle to link the temples at your own pace.

activities.title: Wat Phra That Doi Suthep
activities.summary: A mountainside temple with views over the city, reached by a long staircase or a funicular.

activities.title: Old City temples on foot
activities.summary: Walk between the temples inside the moat, including the ruined great chedi of Wat Chedi Luang.

activities.title: Sunday Walking Street
activities.summary: The old city's main street closes to traffic for crafts and street food.
activities.schedulingNote: Sunday evenings. Check the current schedule.

activities.title: Thai cooking class
activities.summary: A morning market visit and hands-on class, one of the city's specialities.

activities.title: Elephant sanctuary that does not offer riding
activities.summary: Choose a sanctuary that does not offer rides or shows, and research its welfare record first.
activities.schedulingNote: Welfare standards vary widely. Research operators yourself.

activities.title: Doi Inthanon National Park
activities.summary: A day trip to Thailand's highest mountain: waterfalls, cloud forest and hill-tribe villages.

activities.title: Big Buddha (Wat Phra Yai)
activities.summary: A large golden Buddha on a small islet joined to the north-east coast.

activities.title: Ang Thong National Marine Park by boat
activities.summary: A day among limestone islands, with kayaking and a steep climb to a viewpoint.

activities.title: Fisherman's Village evening, Bo Phut
activities.summary: Old wooden shophouses turned restaurants; a walking-street market is held weekly.
activities.schedulingNote: The walking-street market is usually on Fridays. Check the current schedule.

activities.title: Beach day at Chaweng or Lamai
activities.summary: The island's two busiest stretches of sand, with plenty of shade and food nearby.

activities.title: Full-moon party at Hat Rin
activities.summary: An all-night beach party held around the full moon.

recurrence.note: Held around each full moon. Dates shift and can move for religious holidays. Never treat a date as confirmed without checking.

activities.schedulingNote: Recurring event: the planner will not schedule it on a date for you.

activities.title: Than Sadet waterfall and beach
activities.summary: Waterfalls and a quiet cove in the island's national park on the east coast.

activities.title: Bottle Beach by longtail boat
activities.summary: A secluded northern beach most easily reached by boat.

activities.title: West-coast sunset
activities.summary: The island's west coast faces the sunset; an easy evening.

activities.title: Try-dive or snorkel trip
activities.summary: Ko Tao is one of the region's best-known places to learn to dive.
activities.schedulingNote: Choose a certified operator. Diving has medical requirements.

activities.title: Ko Nang Yuan
activities.summary: Three islets joined by sandbars, with a short climb to a famous viewpoint.

activities.title: Viewpoint hike
activities.summary: A short, steep walk to one of the island's lookouts.

activities.title: Cheow Lan Lake by longtail
activities.summary: A day or overnight trip on the reservoir among limestone karsts, often with a cave walk.

activities.title: Guided rainforest walk
activities.summary: Look for gibbons, hornbills and giant plants with a local guide.

activities.title: River canoe or tubing
activities.summary: A gentle float down the river beneath the cliffs.

activities.title: Old Phuket Town
activities.summary: Sino-Portuguese shophouses, cafés and small museums.

activities.title: Big Buddha viewpoint
activities.summary: A huge marble Buddha on a hilltop with views across the south of the island.

activities.title: Phang Nga Bay by boat
activities.summary: Limestone towers, sea caves and lagoons by boat or sea kayak.

activities.title: Night out in Patong
activities.summary: Patong's Bangla Road is the island's loudest nightlife strip.

activities.title: Lard Yai Sunday walking street
activities.summary: Old Phuket Town's main street becomes a food and craft market.
activities.schedulingNote: Sunday evenings. Check the current schedule.

activities.title: Four-islands longtail trip
activities.summary: A classic day of island beaches, snorkelling and sandbars from Ao Nang beach.

activities.title: Tiger Cave Temple climb
activities.summary: Over a thousand steps to a hilltop shrine with views over Krabi's karsts.
activities.schedulingNote: Very steep. Start early to avoid the heat.

activities.title: Half-day rock-climbing lesson
activities.summary: Railay's limestone walls are a world-famous place to try climbing with a guide.

activities.title: Phra Nang cave beach
activities.summary: A beach beneath sheer cliffs with a cave shrine at one end.

activities.title: Viewpoint and lagoon scramble
activities.summary: A steep, muddy rope-assisted climb to a viewpoint and hidden lagoon.

activities.title: National park and lighthouse
activities.summary: Walk the headland at the island's southern tip.

activities.title: Lanta Old Town
activities.summary: A waterfront of wooden stilt houses on the quieter east coast.

activities.title: Snorkelling day to the outer islands
activities.summary: Boat trips run to reefs and islands off Lanta in the drier season.
activities.schedulingNote: Usually only in the drier season; depends on sea conditions.

activities.title: Petronas Towers and KLCC Park
activities.summary: The twin towers, best seen from the park as the lights come on.

activities.title: Batu Caves
activities.summary: A Hindu temple complex inside limestone caves, up a long, steep staircase.

activities.title: Jalan Alor food street
activities.summary: A street of food stalls and open-air restaurants that comes alive at night.

activities.title: Merdeka Square
activities.summary: The colonial-era heart of the city where independence was declared.

activities.title: Heritage and street-art walk
activities.summary: Clan houses, temples, shophouses and murals in the UNESCO-listed core.

activities.title: Hawker food crawl
activities.summary: Penang is famous for its hawker dishes; graze from stall to stall.

activities.title: Penang Hill by funicular
activities.summary: Cooler air and views over the island and the strait.

activities.title: Kek Lok Si Temple
activities.summary: A vast hillside Buddhist temple complex with a seven-storey pagoda.

activities.title: Cable car and Sky Bridge
activities.summary: Ride up through the rainforest to a curved bridge high above the trees.
activities.schedulingNote: Closes in high wind. Check before you go.

activities.title: Kilim mangrove boat trip
activities.summary: A boat through mangrove rivers and limestone, often with eagles overhead.

activities.title: Beach afternoon at Pantai Cenang
activities.summary: The island's main beach, with sunset food stalls nearby.

activities.title: Gardens by the Bay
activities.summary: Conservatories and the Supertree Grove, which light up in the evening.

activities.title: Hawker centre lunch
activities.summary: Singapore's hawker centres serve excellent dishes cheaply in shared halls.

activities.title: Little India and Kampong Glam
activities.summary: Walk between temples, mosques, spice shops and street murals.

activities.title: Sentosa beaches
activities.summary: An island resort a short ride from the city with man-made beaches.
